seat_notes: 19th Assembly, 비례대표 (새누리당 list rank 5), seat 2012-05-30 to 2016-01-18 per the NA API (exit 여성가족부 장관 임명후 의원직 사퇴). The spells file flags end_status conflict (wikilist 2015-12-21, which is the nomination date, and wikiseat 2016-01-19). News supports 2016-01-18. 채널A on 2016-01-16/17 reported she still held the seat after taking office on 01-13, and 충북일보 on 2016-01-19 reported 강은희 여가부장관 사퇴, 18일 의원직 승계.
